meta.positionMethod: FotMob starting XI position codes and nominal minutes; substitutes inferred from recorded named replacement players in OpenFootball (or unambiguous FotMob substitution event). These are role proxies, not tracked dynamic positions. Unresolved high-share position gaps not assigned.
meta.tierMethod: Actual FotMob match ratings weighted by playing minutes, small MOTM/goal-assist contribution and low exposure adjustment; transparent thresholds and awards corroboration; editorial draft and not an independent expert review.
